narrative.Summary: Implement MockVoiceProvider (for deterministic test simulation) and the BaseAgentBridge class (the pluggable STT/TTS bridge). MockVoiceProvider gives developers and tests full programmatic control over call lifecycle without any real network. BaseAgentBridge provides the runtime wiring between STT/TTS providers and a Call's media streams. Together these validate the full SDK contract before any real provider is written.
narrative.Traces: FR-5 (AgentBridge runtime), FR-7 (MockVoiceProvider), NFR-1 (>=85% coverage — this scope provides the test harness for all subsequent scopes)
narrative.Acceptance: MockVoiceProvider.triggerIncoming() fires onCall handler with a fully functional MockCall. MockCall.accept() transitions state to connected. MockCall.getAgentBridge() returns a BaseAgentBridge instance. Agent round-trip integration test passes: simulateVoiceInput → STT mock callback fires → LLM mock reply → injectTTS → TTS mock synthesize called. task check passes >=85% coverage.

items.title: src/providers/mock/mock-call.ts — MockCall implementation
items.narrative: Implements Call interface. State machine transitions driven by accept/reject/hangup/upgradeMode/upgradeMedia. Emits state/media/error/text events. getMediaStream returns an async generator that yields test buffers on demand. sendMedia records sent chunks for test assertions. getAgentBridge returns the attached BaseAgentBridge instance.

items.title: src/providers/mock/mock-voice-provider.ts — MockVoiceProvider
items.narrative: FR-7. Implements VoiceProvider. createCall and joinGroupCall create MockCall instances. triggerIncoming(endpoint, options?) fires registered onCall handlers simulating an inbound call. simulateStateChange(callId, state) transitions a call externally. simulateVoiceInput(callId, transcript, confidence?) triggers the AgentBridge onVoiceInput callback. Maintains internal call registry.

items.title: src/agent-bridge/base-agent-bridge.ts — BaseAgentBridge
items.narrative: FR-5. Implements AgentBridge. Holds optional sttProvider and ttsProvider references (set via setSTTProvider/setTTSProvider). onVoiceInput wires the callback. injectTTS calls ttsProvider.synthesize if set, then calls the Call's sendMedia. injectAudio calls Call's sendMedia directly. Handles no-op gracefully if providers are not set.

items.title: test/mock/mock-call.test.ts — MockCall unit tests
items.narrative: Test all state transitions (initialized→ringing→connecting→connected→held→ended). Test accept/reject/hangup edge cases. Test media stream yields. Test text channel sendText/onText. Test CallError thrown on invalid transitions.

items.title: test/mock/mock-voice-provider.test.ts — MockVoiceProvider unit tests
items.narrative: Test createCall returns MockCall in initialized state. Test triggerIncoming fires onCall. Test simulateStateChange transitions calls. Test simulateVoiceInput fires onVoiceInput on attached bridge.

items.title: test/integration/agent-bridge-round-trip.test.ts — integration test
items.narrative: Full round-trip: create MockVoiceProvider → triggerIncoming → accept call → attach mock STT + mock TTS providers → simulateVoiceInput → verify STT callback fires → call injectTTS → verify TTS synthesize called → verify sendMedia called with synthesized audio. This is the canonical proof that the SDK contract works end-to-end.
